name: The Stone of Golorr (The Grand Game Memories)
description: The specific, infallible memories retained by the Aboleth within the Stone of Golorr pertaining to Waterdeep, the Vault of Dragons, and the current faction war.
key_facts: A crystal-clear memory of former Open Lord Dagult Neverember moving 500,000 gold dragons in small, covered carts in the dead of night.
The agonizing, exhaustive labor of the dwarven masons carving the Vault of Dragons beneath Waterdeep.
Neverember coldly ordering the execution of those same dwarven masons to keep the Vault a secret.
Neverember handing the Dragonstaff of Ahghairon to the gold dragon Aurinax as payment for guarding the gold.
The gold dragon Aurinax transforming into his preferred guise: an elderly dwarf named Barok Clanghammer.
The traumatic, visceral memory of Neverember physically chiseling the three eyes out of the Stone to scatter its memories.
A perfect vision of the first key required to open the Vault doors.
A perfect vision of the second Vault Key.
A blast of psychic static regarding the Third Key; the memory is completely blanked out by the missing eye.
The blurred memory of the Vault's location, recalling the smell of the Brandath family crypts and the damp earth of the City of the Dead.
Victoro and Ammalia Cassalanter signing a contract in blood with a devil, trading the souls of their children for wealth and power.
The specific clause in the infernal contract requiring 99 innocent souls and half a million gold to buy back their children's lives.
A vision of the Cassalanters meticulously calculating lethal doses of midnight tears poison for a future feast.
The drow mercenary Jarlaxle Baenre standing aboard his submarine, the Scarlet Marpenoth, docked secretly beneath the Eyecatcher.
Jarlaxle adjusting his magical disguise to appear as the flamboyant human Captain Zardoz Zord.
The knowledge that every mechanical nimblewright sold by the Sea Maidens Faire contains a scrying sensor feeding information back to Jarlaxle.
The beholder Xanathar disintegrating a loyal lieutenant simply for casting a shadow over his pet goldfish.
The memory of Xanathar's dwarven handlers desperately swapping out a dead goldfish for a new one while the beholder sleeps.
The realization that the Manshoon operating in Waterdeep is just one of many clones, hiding within the extra-dimensional Kolat Towers.
The burning humiliation Manshoon felt when he lost his left arm to Halaster Blackcloak in Undermountain.
Manshoon's chief assassin, Urstul, receiving orders to capture the gnome Dalakhar at all costs.
Dalakhar the gnome frantically running through the streets of Waterdeep, the Stone of Golorr heavy in his pocket, terrified of his pursuers.
Dagult Neverember deliberately keeping his son, Renaer, entirely in the dark about the embezzled gold to protect him.
The rebellious noblewoman Esvele Rosznar strapping on the mask of the Black Viper to escape her family's oppressive expectations.
The potion-maker Skeemo Weirdbottle slipping a coded message to a Zhentarim agent, proving he is betraying the Doom Raiders.
The mind flayer Nihiloor surgically implanting an intellect devourer into the skull of the Waterdhavian hero Meloon Wardragon.
Jarlaxle's drow spy, Nar'l, sweating as he successfully infiltrates Xanathar's inner circle.
Yalah Gralhund seething with jealousy and plotting to use the Zhentarim to intercept the Stone and elevate her family's status.
The exact sequence of events that led to the slaughter inside the Gralhund Villa.
The Blackstaff, Vajra Safahr, weeping in private under the crushing, imposter-syndrome weight of the spirits residing within her magical staff.
Open Lord Laeral Silverhand secretly corresponding with Harper agents, deeply exhausted by the politics of Waterdeep.
The exact magical resonance of the Abjuration magic sealing the Vault—impervious to all scrying and teleportation.
Ahghairon's Dragonward humming beneath the city, creating a physical barrier of nausea that repels any dragon that hasn't touched the Dragonstaff.
The precise arcane command words needed to awaken the gargantuan Walking Statues of Waterdeep (though the Stone cannot speak them).
The location of the teleportation circle in an alleyway that leads directly into Manshoon's sanctum.
The mechanical hum of the dwarven contraption Xanathar uses to sleep, designed to prevent the beholder from accidentally dreaming another beholder into existence.
The genuine, begrudging respect the Doom Raiders have for one another, despite being criminals.
The blueprint of the hidden Temple of Asmodeus located directly beneath the Cassalanter estate.
The true name of the barbed devil summoned by the Cassalanters to enforce their contract.
The stone's own pulsing, acidic hatred for humanity, and its desire to manipulate whoever holds it into releasing it back into the sea.
gm_notes: These memories arm the Stone with the exact leverage needed to manipulate the party against any faction in the city. The AI can pull from these specific secrets to barter or taunt.

name: The Stone of Golorr (Cosmic Memories)
description: The deep, ancestral memories inherited by the Aboleth intelligence within the Stone, spanning the ancient history and dark secrets of the Forgotten Realms.
key_facts: The cold, dark, perfectly ordered universe that existed when the Aboleth Sovereignty ruled, before the divine beings arrived and ruined it.
The exact, intoxicating taste of psychic terror emanating from the very first humanoids to walk Toril.
The sky burning as the meteorites of the Tearfall crashed into Toril, bringing the first dragon eggs to the planet.
The agonizing tearing of the Weave when the Netherese arcanist Karsus tried to mantle the Goddess of Magic, causing magic to temporarily cease existing.
The deafening crash of dozens of floating Netherese cities plummeting from the sky and shattering into the earth.
The archmage Ahghairon magically freezing the Warlord Raurlor's blade mid-swing, establishing the Masked Lords of Waterdeep.
The Mad Mage Halaster Blackcloak and his seven apprentices descending into the caverns beneath Mount Waterdeep for the very first time.
The blinding, geometric complexity of the magical knot Halaster tied into the Weave to create the architecture of Undermountain.
The sprawling, multi-planar empire of the Mind Flayers shattering in a single day when the slave Gith led a violent, psychic rebellion.
The philosophical argument that turned into a bloody civil war, splitting the freed slaves into the Githyanki and the Githzerai.
The scratching of Asmodeus's quill as the gods signed the Pact Primeval, allowing devils to harvest mortal souls.
A horrific vision of Asmodeus's actual body—a miles-long, bleeding serpent resting at the absolute bottom of the Nine Hells.
The blue, roaring fire of the Spellplague washing over Faerûn, twisting flesh, earth, and magic into unrecognizable shapes.
The sky turning gray as the Overgod Ao cast the deities down to walk the earth as mortals.
The cold shock of Helm's gauntlet striking down Mystra on the Celestial Staircase.
The kraken Slarkrethel swimming through the deep ocean, calculating the exact geopolitical assassinations needed to attain godhood.
The identities and locations of every sleeper agent in the Kraken Society operating along the Sword Coast.
The cries of the dark elves as Corellon Larethian cursed them and drove them underground to become the drow.
The Demon Queen of Spiders spinning the first strands of the Demonweb Pits out of her own divine essence.
A flawless, three-dimensional mental map of the drow city of Menzoberranzan, including tunnels lost to time.
The architecture of Ascarle, an elven city that sank into the sea and was subsequently conquered by a kraken.
The slow, rhythmic, tectonic heartbeat of the Tarrasque sleeping near the core of the world.
The exact, stomach-turning alchemical recipe for the potion required to transform a wizard into a lich.
A blurred, heavily warded memory of where the supreme lich of Thay hides his soul.
The Netherese arcanist Ioulaum activating the very first mythallar, tapping directly into raw magic.
The low, subsonic vibration of a purple worm's mating call echoing through the Underdark.
A tribe of insane, fish-like Kuo-toa worshiping a statue of a lobster so fervently that their collective belief sparked it into a living, breathing minor god.
The mortal name of the Raven Queen before she ascended to godhood.
The location of the lost portals the Imaskar Empire used to abduct humans from other worlds to serve as slaves.
The avatars of the Egyptian pantheon arriving on Toril to save their enslaved worshippers from the Imaskari.
A mind-shattering glimpse of the Far Realm, a dimension of non-euclidean geometry and writhing tentacles where the laws of physics do not exist.
The horrifying truth that when an Elder Brain consumes a dying mind flayer's brain, it absorbs their knowledge but destroys their consciousness.
The paranoid, circular nightmare a beholder must dream in order to rise as an undead Death Tyrant.
The exact moment a demon and a devil first locked eyes on the plains of Avernus, starting a war that will outlast the stars.
A subtle, microscopic weakness in the magical wards protecting the great library of Candlekeep from fire.
The exact coordinates beneath the shifting sands of Anauroch where ten of the golden Netherese Scrolls remain buried.
The lost brewing recipe for a legendary ale from the fallen dwarven kingdom of Gauntlgrym.
The knowledge that the most famous heroic ballad of the last century was actually plagiarized from a drunken goblin.
The location of a massive cavern in the Spine of the World filled entirely with the shed scales and hoarded wealth of an ancient, deceased gold dragon.
The password and location of an abandoned Harper weapons cache hidden behind a waterfall near Silverymoon.
The exact weight and chemical composition of the gold pieces minted in Cormyr during the year 1350 DR.
A deeply hidden secret regarding the illegitimacy of a past king of Cormyr.
A shimmering, glowing map of the magical leylines that crisscross the continent of Faerûn.
The arrogant, pulsing psychic voice of Crenshinibon, the sentient crystal shard, before it was destroyed.
The profound, collective sorrow of the Elves during the Retreat, as they abandoned their mainland empires for the isle of Evermeet.
The arcane harmonics used to weave the mythal that once protected the great elven city of Myth Drannor.
The brutal, bloody ascension of Maglubiyet as he slaughtered the pantheons of other goblinoid races to enforce absolute loyalty.
The dark pact struck by the first mortal to be cursed with vampirism in the Realms.
The unspeakable, multisyllabic true name of the Eldest—the aboleth who spawned Golorr's specific lineage.
The schematic and biological blueprints required to grow a mind flayer spelljamming ship.
The metallurgical and psychic process used by the githyanki to forge swords that can sever the silver cords of astral travelers.
The exact layout of the Grand Bazaar within the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire.
The memory of an ancient Djinni shedding a single tear as he was bound into an iron flask.
The exact number and location of the remaining beholder hive-mothers slumbering in the deep Underdark.
The coordinates of a ruined spelljamming helm buried deep beneath the canopy of the High Forest.
The true, slightly embarrassing fate of Volo's great-grandfather, a 'great explorer' who actually just got lost in a very mundane cave.
The verbal, somatic, and material components of a mythical 10th-level spell capable of shearing the top off a mountain.
A vivid, breathtaking memory of the sun setting over the hyper-advanced empire of Imaskar, one day before its total collapse.
The chilling silence of Myrkul's throne room in the City of Judgment.
The infinite, crushing psychic weight of remembering every lie ever successfully told by a mortal in the history of the multiverse.
gm_notes: These entries allow the Stone to drop terrifyingly accurate lore about the broader universe. If the party asks it a question completely unrelated to Waterdeep, the Stone can answer it flawlessly, reinforcing its status as an omniscient, ancient entity.
